races.paceDynamic: Bellini Spirit will take the field along as the sole genuine front runner, but faces immediate pressure from four prominent runners - Believeinmenow, Dragon Spin, Solar Invincible and Rogue Rebellion - all wanting to track closely behind. This congestion will create a strong gallop through the early furlongs as these five horses jostle for position. The pace will be solid but not destructive, with the real drama coming 2-3 furlongs out when the prominent pack starts fanning wide for racing room while hold-up horses Luna Beaux, Jenny Jerome and Beach Partee unleash their finishing kicks. This tactical setup clearly favours the closers who can avoid the early scrimmaging and benefit from the strong pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack goes too hard chasing Bellini Spirit in the early stages...
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for Luna Beaux and Beach Partee to sweep past tiring leaders. Both have shown lethal finishing kicks at this trip and can capitalise on tactical chaos ahead.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runner prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking quartet can secure the ideal position without getting caught wide...
scenarios.body: Dragon Spin or Solar Invincible could kick clear before the closers get organised. Their racing fitness and tactical speed gives them the edge over the front runner and hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner holds on
scenarios.trigger: If Bellini Spirit gets soft sectionals with the prominent runners hesitating early...
scenarios.body: The leader could steal a crucial advantage and prove tough to peg back despite the closers' late charge. Carson can dictate terms and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Traffic chaos decides
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes major interference 2f out...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with several chances compromised by lack of racing room. An outsider avoiding trouble could sneak through for place money at best.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit and Angel Shared will contest the early lead, with Ruby's Profit likely to get first run as the stronger front-runner. Six runners want prominent positions (Beautiful Diamond, Hold A Dream, Shine On Me, Arugam Bay, Temple Of Athena, Cindy Lou Who) creating dangerous congestion through the first 2-3 furlongs at Bath's tight track. The pace should be honest but not destructive over 5f, with the prominent pack bunching dangerously approaching the final furlong. This setup clearly favours hold-up horses who can avoid the early scrimmaging and find racing room late - Azure Angel, Miss Attitude, Flowerhead, Palmeira and Billie Be Quick all benefit from staying out of trouble.

races.paceDynamic: So Smart will lead from the start with no other confirmed front-runners, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure. The prominent runners Level Up, Twilight Madness, Reporter, Call Time, Secret Handsheikh and Tilsworth Ony Ta will track behind in a loose pack. The large group of hold-up horses including The Feminine Urge, Dandy Dinmont, Hidden Verse, Dragon God, Diamondsinthesand and Symbol Of Hope will be forced to come from well back. This uncontested early pace strongly favours the prominent runners who can track the leader without cover problems, while the hold-up horses face a significant tactical disadvantage in a bunched field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart sets steady fractions without being challenged early
scenarios.body: The prominent pack gets perfect positioning behind the uncontested leader and can time their runs perfectly. Hold-up horses struggle to find gaps and get there too late in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes very sedate and the field compresses turning for home
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get the slow early pace they need and can unleash powerful finishing kicks. Class horses like The Feminine Urge and Hidden Verse can overcome their poor draws.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart gets soft lead and kicks clear entering final furlong
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader has enough left in the tank to resist late challengers after controlling the race throughout. Prominent runners pick up the pieces behind the winner.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If So Smart stops quickly and prominent runners also tire from tracking
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery as early leaders fade dramatically in the final 100 yards. Hold-up horses with strongest finishing kicks profit from the pace collapse.
